title: UvA-MT's Participation in the WMT26 General Translation Shared Task
abstract: arXiv:2610.27852v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents UvA-MT's submission to the WMT 2026 General Machine Translation shared task, competing in the unconstrained track across all 23 translation directions. This year, we fully leverage the test-time methods of Large Language Models (LLMs) for machine translation. Specifically, (1) we use sequential sampling with a refinement prompt to generate a pool of translation candidates for each source segment, a strategy shown to outperform traditional parallel sampling; and (2) we employ LLMs as pairwise judges to select the best candidate via a round-robin voting mechanism, with offline evaluation on the WMT25 benchmark showing a very clear improvement over point-wise best-of-N selection. Combined, these two strategies form our WMT26 submission.

translated_title: UvA-MT 团队参与 WMT26 通用翻译共享任务
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了 UvA-MT 团队参加 WMT 2026 通用机器翻译共享任务的提交系统，该系统以无约束赛道参与全部 23 个翻译方向。今年，我们充分借助大语言模型（LLM）在机器翻译中的测试时方法。具体而言：（1）我们使用带有润色提示的顺序采样为每个源语言片段生成一组翻译候选，该策略已被证明优于传统的并行采样；（2）我们采用大语言模型作为成对评委，通过循环投票机制选出最佳候选译文，在 WMT25 基准上的离线评估显示，该方法相比逐点式 best-of-N 选择有非常明显的提升。这两种策略相结合，构成了我们参加 WMT26 的最终提交系统。
tldr: UvA-MT 团队在 WMT26 通用机器翻译任务中，利用大语言模型顺序采样生成翻译候选，并通过 LLM 成对评委的循环投票机制选出最佳译文，参与了全部 23 个翻译方向。
